scenes.summary: You increased the operations level for the depot node. Bonnie is grateful.

lines.text: I didn't expect you to increase the operations level so quickly. That's fantastic!
These supplies can reach those in need even faster now!
No time to waste. Let's proceed with packing goods, redistribution bids, and initiate delivery!
Endfield Express — your success, we profess!
Thank you for all you've done for Endfield Express, Endmin.
I'll keep striving to follow your example!

options: Endfield Express, where duty meets delivery!
